mapper.sql: id, verification_id, contract_code, financial_contract_status, account_date, client_name, org_id, receivable_rent, receivable_residual_value, receivable_downpayment, receivable_commission, receivable_insurance, receivable_otherincome, receivable_outtax, unrealized_revenue, payable_device_estimate, payable_agency_estimate, payable_vehicle_estimate, payable_band_cost_estimate, payable_pledge_estimate, payable_unpledge_estimate, payable_other_cost_estimate, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, financial_expense_amount, compensation_provision_amount, client_code, depreciation_reserves
mapper.select: select a.contract_code, a.client_code, a.client_name, a.org_id, a.financial_contract_status, a.account_date, (a.receivable_rent_balance + coalesce(b.receivable_rent_amount,0)) as receivable_rent, (a.receivable_residual_value_balance + coalesce(b.receivable_residual_value_amount,0)) as receivable_residual_value, (a.receivable_downpayment_balance + coalesce(b.receivable_downpayment_amount,0)) as receivable_downpayment, (a.receivable_commission_balance + coalesce(b.receivable_commission_amount,0)) as receivable_commission, (a.receivable_insurance_balance + coalesce(b.receivable_insurance_amount,0)) as receivable_insurance, (a.receivable_otherincome_balance + coalesce(b.receivable_otherincome_amount,0)) as receivable_otherincome, (a.receivable_outtax_balance + coalesce(b.receivable_outtax_amount,0)) as receivable_outtax, (a.unrealized_revenue_balance + coalesce(b.unrealized_revenue_amount,0)) as unrealized_revenue, (a.payable_device_estimate_balance + coalesce(b.payable_device_estimate_amount,0)) as payable_device_estimate, (a.payable_agency_estimate_balance + coalesce(b.payable_agency_estimate_amount,0)) as payable_agency_estimate, (a.payable_vehicle_estimate_balance + coalesce(b.payable_vehicle_estimate_amount,0)) as payable_vehicle_estimate, (a.payable_band_cost_estimate_balance + coalesce(b.payable_band_cost_estimate_amount,0)) as payable_band_cost_estimate, (a.payable_pledge_estimate_balance + coalesce(b.payable_pledge_estimate_amount,0)) as payable_pledge_estimate, (a.payable_unpledge_estimate_balance + coalesce(b.payable_unpledge_estimate_amount,0)) as payable_unpledge_estimate, (a.depreciation_reserves_balance + coalesce(b.depreciation_reserves_amount,0)) as depreciation_reserves from ( select evd.contract_code, evd.client_code, evd.client_name, evd.org_id, evd.financial_contract_status, evd.account_date, sum(coalesce(el.receivable_rent_balance , 0)) as receivable_rent_balance, sum(coalesce(el.receivable_residual_value_balance, 0)) as receivable_residual_value_balance, sum(coalesce(el.receivable_downpayment_balance, 0)) as receivable_downpayment_balance, sum(coalesce(el.receivable_commission_balance, 0)) as receivable_commission_balance, sum(coalesce(el.receivable_insurance_balance, 0)) as receivable_insurance_balance, sum(coalesce(el.receivable_otherincome_balance, 0)) as receivable_otherincome_balance, sum(coalesce(el.receivable_outtax_balance, 0)) as receivable_outtax_balance, sum(coalesce(el.unrealized_revenue_balance, 0)) as unrealized_revenue_balance, sum(coalesce(el.payable_device_estimate_balance, 0)) as payable_device_estimate_balance, sum(coalesce(el.payable_agency_estimate_balance, 0)) as payable_agency_estimate_balance, sum(coalesce(el.payable_vehicle_estimate_balance, 0)) as payable_vehicle_estimate_balance, sum(coalesce(el.payable_band_cost_estimate_balance, 0)) as payable_band_cost_estimate_balance, sum(coalesce(el.payable_pledge_estimate_balance, 0)) as payable_pledge_estimate_balance, sum(coalesce(el.payable_unpledge_estimate_balance, 0)) as payable_unpledge_estimate_balance, sum(coalesce(el.depreciation_reserves_balance, 0)) as depreciation_reserves_balance from eg_verification ev inner join eg_verification_details evd on ev.id = evd.verification_id left join eg_contract_balance_latest el on evd.contract_code = el.contract_code and evd.org_id = el.org_id and el.del_flag = '0' where 1 = 1 and ev.del_flag = '0' and evd.del_flag = '0' and ev.id = #{param.id} group by evd.contract_code, evd.client_code, evd.client_name, evd.org_id, evd.financial_contract_status, evd.account_date ) a left join ( select max(t.interface_data_id), t.contract_code, t.org_id, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_rent_amount, 0)) as receivable_rent_amount, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_residual_value_amount, 0)) as receivable_residual_value_amount, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_downpayment_amount, 0)) as receivable_downpayment_amount, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_commission_amount, 0)) as receivable_commission_amount, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_insurance_amount, 0)) as receivable_insurance_amount, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_otherincome_amount, 0)) as receivable_otherincome_amount, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_outtax_amount, 0)) as receivable_outtax_amount, sum(coalesce(t.unrealized_revenue_amount, 0)) as unrealized_revenue_amount, sum(coalesce(t.payable_device_estimate_amount, 0)) as payable_device_estimate_amount, sum(coalesce(t.payable_agency_estimate_amount, 0)) as payable_agency_estimate_amount, sum(coalesce(t.payable_vehicle_estimate_amount, 0)) as payable_vehicle_estimate_amount, sum(coalesce(t.payable_band_cost_estimate_amount, 0)) as payable_band_cost_estimate_amount, sum(coalesce(t.payable_pledge_estimate_amount, 0)) as payable_pledge_estimate_amount, sum(coalesce(t.payable_unpledge_estimate_amount, 0)) as payable_unpledge_estimate_amount, sum(coalesce(t.depreciation_reserves_amount, 0)) as depreciation_reserves_amount from eg_contract_balance_temp t where 1 = 1 and t.del_flag='0' and t.scene_code = 'HZHX' group by t.contract_code, t.org_id ) b on a.contract_code = b.contract_code and b.org_id = a.org_id where 1 = 1
